audio.caption_basis: ASR of actual clean stock narration and independently transcribed authentic archival source, shifted with the exact sample edit; separate encoded-mix transcript cross-check.
audio.alignment_limit: Three word onsets differ by up to0.44s between independent ASR passes; ASR is approximate, not human-confirmed phoneme alignment. Caption groups preserve the speaker boundary.

visual_inspection.portrait_framing: Actual source fills portrait, with proportional crops; no tiny landscape/blur cards.
observed_limitations: Archival JFK and Moon TV pictures are soft/grainy and upscaled; no native-HD claim.
Launch film has genuine frame/perforation/brightness artifacts; no generated detail or restoration claim.
This is a historical editorial motivational pilot, not a proven best-performing format.
The assistant cannot subjectively hear playback in this runtime; actual soundtrack transcript, waveform/level/timing and full decode checks were used.

editorial_review.originality: New narration and six-shot edit using three source assets; no copied creator script, stock-card batch or fabricated celebrity voice.
